summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen, formerly of St. Louis but now in London, challenged John Dwyer or any man for $1,000 a side, in Canada within 100 miles of Buffalo or within 50 miles of Pittsburg.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, Friday Morning, November 21, 1879 (page 1). New York dispatch dated Nov. 20.

facts.fact: From London, Allen challenged John Dwyer or any man in the world to fight at catch weights under London prize ring rules for $1,000 a side, to contest Dwyer's title to the championship of America
Allen proposed the fight take place in Canada within 100 miles of Buffalo or within 50 miles of Pittsburg
Allen, formerly of St. Louis, was living in London in November 1879
Dwyer, out of training and entering politics, was not expected to accept Allen's challenge
